behaviors.assignee-options: Opening the Assignee dropdown shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with their task counts.
behaviors.search-assignees: Typing a name in Find a person narrows the dropdown options.
behaviors.filter-by-person: Selecting Priya shows only her tasks, including when a status filter is also active.
behaviors.filter-unassigned: Selecting Unassigned shows the unassigned task.
behaviors.assignee-empty-state: Selecting Ana shows an empty state saying nothing is assigned to her yet, with a Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters restores All statuses and Anyone, shows all tasks, and hides the toolbar reset control.

history.notes: The toolbar selectors distinguish the filter controls from task card controls. Dropdown options are located by their visible labels, and counts are checked separately.
